items.definition:
good-looking (especially for a man)
He is a very handsome man with a kind smile.

giving a sense of happy satisfaction or enjoyment
We had a very pleasant evening together.

intelligent, smart
She is a very clever student.

relating to Sweden, its people, or its language
She is learning Swedish.

relating to Switzerland, its people, or its languages
He loves Swiss chocolate.

mild and kind
He has a very gentle nature.

nervous or timid in the company of other people
The shy child hid behind her mother.

not asleep
I was still awake when the sun came up.

empty; without writing or images
The page was completely blank.

located or used inside a building
We played indoor games because of the rain.

having light-colored hair
She has beautiful blonde hair.

reduced by the subtraction of; indicating a negative quantity
The temperature dropped to minus five degrees Celsius.

tidy
Her room is always very neat.

very thin
He was a tall, skinny boy.

painful
My muscles are sore after the workout.

not correct or true
Your answer is incorrect.

feeling or expressing gratitude
I am thankful for your help.

having good manners
It's polite to say 'please' and 'thank you'.

pleasant; giving pleasure
We had a very enjoyable evening.

available to be chosen but not obligatory
Attending the meeting is optional.

reflecting light; bright
The car had a shiny new coat of paint.

having an acidic taste
The lemon was very sour.

untidy or dirty
His room is always messy.

having a pleasant flavor
This cake is very tasty.

cheerful and lively
We wished everyone a merry Christmas.

disobedient, mischievous
The naughty child wouldn't share his toys.

made at home rather than in a store or factory
I prefer homemade cookies to store-bought ones.

relating to Austria
My friend is an Austrian citizen.

full of color; vivid
The garden was full of colorful flowers.

hot-tasting
This curry is very spicy.

adhesive
The jam made my fingers sticky.

containing as much as possible; not empty
After dinner, my stomach felt much fuller.

causing laughter or providing entertainment
The comedian told an amusing story.

having a lot of rain
It's going to be a rainy day tomorrow.

tasting of salt
These chips are too salty for me.

not good for health
Eating too much fast food is unhealthy.

covered with dust
The old books were very dusty.

Making a lot of noise.
The children were very noisy during playtime.

fully developed and ready to be eaten (for fruit/vegetables)
The bananas are ripe and ready to eat.

fast; rapid
The car made a speedy getaway.

having or bringing bad luck
He felt unlucky after losing the game.

having the shape of a rectangle
The table has a rectangular top.

not known or recognized
The new city felt unfamiliar to her.

difficult to hold or stand on because it is smooth, wet, or greasy
Be careful; the floor is very slippery.

noticeably happy and optimistic
She always has a cheerful smile on her face.

having curls or a curved shape
She has beautiful curly hair.

covered in or full of mud
After the rain, the path became very muddy.

covered with, or resembling, fluff
The kitten had soft, fluffy fur.

characterized by strong winds
It was a very windy day at the beach.

having light-colored hair
She has long, blond hair.

covered with clouds; not clear
The sky was cloudy all morning, but it cleared up in the afternoon.

delicious
The cake was so yummy!

unpleasantly cold
It's a bit chilly outside, so wear a jacket.

covered with snow; resembling snow
It was a beautiful snowy day.

characterized by strong winds and heavy rain or snow
We stayed indoors on the stormy day.

covered with or resembling grease or oil
The fast food was too greasy for my taste.

(of food) pleasantly thin, dry, and easily broken.
I love crispy bacon for breakfast.

causing an irritating sensation on the skin
My skin feels really itchy after the mosquito bite.

Resembling a dog; characteristic of a dog.
The puppy gave a cute doggy yawn.

pale sandy brown in color
She painted her living room light beige.

friendly, helpful, and considerate
She is kinder than her sister.

having a strong or unpleasant smell
The garbage can was very smelly.

slightly crazy; trivial
He's gone a bit potty with all this stress.

not important
The details are unimportant for now.
